description: Bassins versants topographiques des axes de ruissellement sur Rennes Métropole is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole - Direction de l'Espace public et des Infrastructures - Unité Etudes Hydrauliques. This layer complements the layer of runoff axes on Rennes Métropole (UUID = e0fa5c09-ee44-46ff-a068-b6dada575c9f) by topographic analysis. As part of the runoff study currently being carried out by Rennes Métropole (2023-2025), a first analysis of hydraulic functioning was carried out at the global scale of its territory. Coverage: Rennes Métropole - Direction de l'Espace public et des Infrastructures - Unité Etudes Hydrauliques. The portal shows the English title as "Topographical watersheds of runoff axes on Rennes Métropole" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Rennes Métropole - Direction de l'Espace public et des Infrastructures - Unité Etudes Hydrauliques. Its keywords include reseau-hydrographique, bassin-versant, environnement. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, CSV, ZIP. The listing shows 2024-03-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
